name: Admin Local Tasks
description: Restyles Drupal's local-task (tabs) block into a fixed, minimalistic icon menu pinned to the left or right for logged-in users on non-admin (front-end) routes, with optional tooltips.
project_description:
Admin Local Tasks makes Drupal's (admin) Local Task links fancier and more accessible for content editors on non-admin routes (front pages), giving them a minimalistic design and a fixed position on the left or right of the screen. It targets the local-tasks (primary/secondary tabs) block: for authenticated users viewing a front-end (non-admin) route, it attaches a CSS/JS library and overrides the menu-local-tasks template so the tabs render as a compact icon menu; on admin routes the standard core tabs are left in place.

A settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/admin-local-tasks (permission 'administer admin_local_tasks') controls the appearance: screen side (left/right) and whether link titles are shown as hover tooltips (via the bundled Tippy.js). Each local task is mapped to an icon class by route name (view/edit/delete/revisions/translate/clone/etc.), and the hook_local_tasks_mapping_alter() hook lets other modules extend or change those mappings for custom icons. The module ships icon SVGs, a base stylesheet, and a Tippy tooltip behavior. It was started from the Better Local Tasks module as an initial reference.
